title: Software modification - Vaporize Microsoft Store technical pipeline backlog

stateResults.summary: Existing Info.plist and Package.resolved modifications predate this exact two-file backlog slice and remain excluded.

The Windows package, identity, signing, certification, lifecycle-test, Partner Center handoff, and authorized rollout evidence responsibilities are now explicit.
No implementation, credential use, external submission, publication, or approval is claimed.
